解锁「今日菜单」按钮：开饭前划掉不想要的菜，它就不会再出，同窗口的其他菜出得更多: Unlock Today’s Menu: cross out dishes before a meal so their stall serves the other choices more often. Each level lets you remove one more dish. Every open stall must keep at least one dish.
抛下来的菜有几率是「优质菜」：带银色扫光，价值 ×2。每级几率 +8%。: Thrown dishes can be Premium, with a silver sheen and twice the value. Each level adds an 8% chance.
优质菜有几率直接升成「金牌菜」：带金色辉光，价值 ×4。每级几率 +20%。: Premium dishes can become Gold, with a golden glow and four times the value. Each level adds a 20% chance.
菜掉进饭盒时，有几率变成同窗口、同类的高一级菜（比如青菜 → 土豆丝）；已经最高: When a dish lands in your box, it may become the next dish from the same stall and food category. A top-tier dish gains a quality grade instead. Changed dishes glow with a little flame and are worth ×1.5. Ingredients needed for your closest recipe are protected. Each level adds an 8% chance.
小炒套餐每级 +0.2 倍。亲手送出装满同一道散菜的饭盒（至少两份），就是「单品: Each level adds 0.2 to simple-set multipliers. Personally serve a full box of one loose dish, with at least two servings, to make a Single-Dish Platter: +10% box income per level, and it qualifies for combos. Mixed grades are fine; ghosts do not count. Platters do not unlock cookbook recipes.
换更好的饭盒：铁 → 铜 → 银 → 金，整顿收入 ×1.5 / ×2 / ×3: Upgrade your box: Iron → Copper → Silver → Gold, for ×1.5 / ×2 / ×3 meal income. Material boosts income. To pull food closer, use Divergent Thinking during Deep Thinking.
套餐少占 1 格（最少 1 格）。亲手送出含套餐且空着至少两格的饭盒，存一份「余: Sets take one fewer cell, with a minimum of one. Personally serve a box containing a set and at least two empty cells to store a Spare-Space Cache. Your next personally served full box earns +15%. It holds one charge; use it, then prepare another.
饭盒里有 3 份菜名、品级和火苗状态都相同的散菜时，合成 1 份更高品级的（普通: Three loose servings of the same dish, grade and flame status merge into one higher-grade serving: Regular → Premium → Gold. The result keeps that dish’s normal cell size, freeing the other two servings’ space.
饭盒装满，又没有只差一样的套餐时，3 样来自不同窗口的散菜自动压成一份「乱炖」（: When your box is full and no recipe is just one ingredient away, three loose dishes from different stalls combine into a tier-two Mixed Stew, freeing space.
连着送出「至少两份二级以上套餐」或已学会的「单品拼盘」，就能叠连击，让之后的饭盒: Keep serving boxes with at least two tier-two-or-higher sets, or learned Single-Dish Platters, to build a combo and boost later boxes. A qualifying box shows Combo ✓. An ordinary box breaks the chain.
连击断了，1 级只掉一半，2 级每顿第一次断掉不算。另有「换菜接力」：连续两盒单: At level 1, a broken combo loses only half its count. At level 2, the first break each meal is ignored. Also gain Dish Relay: switch dishes between consecutive Single-Dish Platters for +10% per level on the later box. An ordinary box interrupts the relay.
开窍以后，她吃的青菜一半算素、一半算荤，更容易凑齐荤素；仍然需要主食才能吃得均衡: After Grokking, eaten greens count as half vegetables and half meat. You still need staples for a balanced meal.
关门时，桌上、你手里和小助手盒里没吃完的菜，她会在梦里吃掉；按食物的一半价值结算: At closing time, she eats the leftovers on the table, in your hands and in helpers’ boxes in her dreams. They pay half their food value, then receive the meal bonuses.
R1 送你的能力：按住空格、右键或手柄 B，菜落得更慢。结束后冷却 1 秒，松开: A free R1 ability: hold Space, right mouse or controller B to slow falling food. When it ends, wait one second and release before starting again. Each level of this ticket adds one second of thinking time.
评测：一顿赚到 6 万 token 就发布 V3.2，解锁新技能。未学「顿悟」时: Trial: earn 60,000 tokens in one meal to release V3.2 and unlock new skills. Your box avoids greens unless you have learned Grokking. V3.1-Terminus finally stops saying “极” everywhere.
